changelog: Web UI tunnel: remember each miner's Digest auth challenge instead of starting every single file with a Basic attempt the miner always rejects — halves the requests needed to load an Antminer page
Web UI tunnel: reuse one keep-alive connection per miner rather than opening a fresh TCP connection for every file, which these small embedded web servers are slow to accept

Web UI tunnel: retry once when a busy miner refuses or resets a connection, instead of immediately returning 502 — this is what left the dashboard's own stats.cgi/pools.cgi/warning.cgi polls failing and panels stuck on stale readings
Log download: HTTP status codes were ignored, so a miner's 404 or 401 error page came back as a perfectly valid-looking 'log' and stopped the search before reaching the endpoint that actually works
Log download: collect from the syslog, system info and CGMiner API together, syslog first, instead of returning whichever endpoint answered first

Web UI tunnel: serve a few files at a time per miner instead of strictly one after another. Full serialisation meant the later files on a large page were still queued when the backend's 12s budget expired, so the tail of every Antminer dashboard failed — including its language dictionary, which is why labels rendered as [rate] and [algorithm] instead of their real names
Web UI tunnel: drop a queued request whose caller has already given up, rather than spending the miner's limited capacity on a response nobody is waiting for
